verdict.rationale: The open Business & Liens portal offers a public search by business name or file number, so a founder can pull up their filed record. An Online Account keeps a transaction history of completed filings for 90 days, but that sits behind a login rather than on public pages. Nothing shows a public tracker for pending filings or applications, and the refund-status tool belongs to the Department of Revenue, not this registry. missing for 10: explicit public status display for pending filings/applications, status lookup without login beyond 90-day completed history, hands-on corroboration that search results show filing status.

support.subject: As a founder, I can look up the status of my filing, application, or case from the service's public pages

citations.quote: Search: Business Name or File Number
An Online Account will maintain a Transaction History with links to view and print your completed filings for up to 90 days.
